title: Generic Solar / Wind Validation Methodology (Framework + Migration Sketch)

files_changed.rationale: 17-section framework document: terminology inheritance from existing codebase; 'Validated' definition with 6 objective criteria; 4-level maturity ladder (Concept / Exploratory / Reference / Validated); validation pack contents; reference projects today; migration sketch for Generic Wind; migration sketch for Generic Solar; UI / export / audit labeling; forbidden claims; governance gates; relationship to existing roadmap; recommended sequence (F1-F5+); hard no-go; forbidden paths; stop-after-report contract; appendix.

terminology_inheritance.Reference: inherited from D1 audit sheet 'Reference-status only' (Level 2)
terminology_inheritance.Exploratory_Unvalidated: inherited from D1 audit sheet 'EXPLORATORY / UNVALIDATED' (Level 1)
terminology_inheritance.Production_Ready: explicitly NOT used in F1 — would overclaim commercial / bankability status
terminology_inheritance.Bankable_Lender_grade: inherited from docs/external_review/no_go_claims.md as forbidden at all levels

maturity_ladder.name: Concept
maturity_ladder.definition: A project idea exists; no input pack, no Excel reference, no test pack.

maturity_ladder.name: Exploratory / Unvalidated
maturity_ladder.definition: An input pack exists; the model can run the project; no parity, no test pack, no known-limitation doc.

maturity_ladder.name: Reference
maturity_ladder.definition: Excel parity achieved and pinned; audit exports available; known limitations documented; test pack exists and passes; rc1-level freeze applies.

maturity_ladder.name: Validated
maturity_ladder.definition: All six 'Validated' criteria met, including external reviewer sign-off and a golden dataset.

validated_criteria: Excel parity achieved (Phase 51F parity guardrails green)
Test coverage threshold (per-feature test pack exists; passes in isolation and full stack)
Audit exports available (D1 Depreciation Audit sheet, full parity-validated export)
Reviewer sign-off completed (external reviewer, closure-review format)
Golden dataset exists (frozen input + frozen expected output, both committed and versioned)

requirements_for_level_2: D1 audit sheet update to REFERENCE (part of F2 PR)
requirements_for_level_3: Golden dataset (frozen input + frozen expected output)

requirements_for_level_2: Solar-specific known-limitations doc (DC/AC ratio, tracker, albedo, tax)
D1 audit sheet update to REFERENCE (part of F3 PR)

ui_labeling.run_banner: shows project level (REFERENCE or EXPLORATORY / UNVALIDATED); does NOT show VALIDATED for any project today
ui_labeling.exports: Depreciation Audit sheet shows project level as REFERENCE or EXPLORATORY / UNVALIDATED
ui_labeling.audit_sheets: existing D1 sheet wording preserved; future rename to Generic_Project_Validation_Status is out of scope for F1

promotion_to_level_2: All dedicated tests pass in isolation and in full 57-arc stack
D1 audit sheet row updated to REFERENCE
User sign-off (human driving project) approves promotion
promotion_to_level_3: Golden dataset exists and is referenced by test pack
User sign-off (human driving project) approves promotion
demotion_triggers: Parity regression in Phase 51F parity guardrails
Dedicated test failure that cannot be fixed within one sprint
KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md not updated for more than 90 days while project in active use
governance_gates.demotion_process: separate PR that updates audit-sheet row back to EXPLORATORY / UNVALIDATED; must include written rationale

relationship_to_existing_roadmap.CAPEX_2_0_sub_lines: runtime-orthogonal to F1; F2/F3 should include CAPEX sub-line coverage in dedicated test pack
relationship_to_existing_roadmap.depreciation_enablement: runtime-orthogonal to F1; F2/F3 must keep Generic_Project_Support: NO or extend deprecation arc in future governance review
relationship_to_existing_roadmap.IDC_schedule_work: F1 is independent; F2/F3 should re-evaluate after IDC design gate is settled
relationship_to_existing_roadmap.OPEX_runtime: F1 is independent; F2/F3 should re-evaluate after OPEX runtime is settled
relationship_to_existing_roadmap.formula_transparency: F1 is independent; will likely help F2/F3 (KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md)

recommended_sequence.scope: Generic Solar → Reference (multi-PR, can run parallel to F2)

stop_after_report_contract.next_phase_start: F2 (Generic Wind → Reference) and F3 (Generic Solar → Reference), each in its own follow-up prompt
stop_after_report_contract.rationale: F1 is framework definition only. F2 / F3 are detailed execution. F1 explicitly does NOT start F2 or F3.
